species.real: DNA from museum skins shows the warrah's closest living relative is South America's maned wolf, and it probably reached the islands when Ice Age seas were low.
species.name: Warrah

dex.text: The only land mammal the Falkland Islands ever had, a fox-wolf with a white tail tip, and it walked up to visitors without a care. That was the mistake.
dex.fact: The Falkland Islands wolf, or warrah, was the islands' only native land mammal, and was hunted to extinction by 1876; Darwin noted that it was tame, and predicted its end.
